preserved_invariants: frozen W0-W18 semantics and every merged package/app/test untouched; only the five owned paths are created
every consequential action re-evaluates the CURRENT authority grant at action time; a grant held at planning time is never sufficient
expired, revoked, or never-held grants fail closed as typed ACTION_AUTHORITY_DENIED denials; executors never run; no retry-until-success
no self-approval: an evaluator bound to a body/actor cannot certify that actor's output (typed EVALUATION_INDEPENDENCE_VIOLATION before the probe runs)
action outcomes and verdicts are content-addressed and bound to the exact source and deployment revisions they acted on or evaluated
rollback is a first-class action with its own evidence chain: what, from which revision to which, why, plus a verification observation of the rolled-back state (honestly UNKNOWN when unobservable)
client-supplied idempotency keys with replay protection: duplicates return the recorded original outcome exactly once; event appends deduplicate
aggregation is evidence combination only; summaries carry certification NOT_ASSERTED and never certify mission success
LLM/reasoning output is advisory-only, labelled ADVISORY_REASONING and non-authoritative, ledgered separately, and never an evidence source
honest statuses: NOT_YET_CONNECTED probes and executors never fabricate real-provider evidence; absent evidence yields UNKNOWN, never PASS
the action gateway carries no authority fields of its own; smuggled authority keys are typed rejections naming the field
zero new external dependencies; pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml unchanged; offline determinism outside the documented apps/actions composition boundary
boundary_changes: packages/action-gateway: new leaf workspace member (no workspace imports); consumed only by packages/evaluator, packages/evaluation-orchestration, apps/actions, tests/actions-and-evaluation
packages/evaluator: new workspace member; imports only @sos-2/action-gateway (P9-owned)
packages/evaluation-orchestration: new workspace member; imports only @sos-2/action-gateway and @sos-2/evaluator (P9-owned)
apps/actions: new composition-root app; imports only P9-owned members; nothing at this base consumes it
tests/actions-and-evaluation: new acceptance suite; imports only P9-owned members and vitest
